Camille|sup.identity: Physical damage dive fighter. Adaptive Defenses (passive): attacking a champion gives her a shield against that enemy's damage type. Precision Protocol (Q) empowers her next attack and can be recast (much stronger if she waits between the two), Tactical Sweep (W) strikes a cone after a delay (the outer edge slows and heals her), Hookshot (E) latches her onto a wall, then launches her at enemies, stunning them on landing, and The Hextech Ultimatum (R) makes her leap onto a champion to trap them with her in a zone.
Camille|sup.playstyle: Dive support: she engages from walls with her Hookshot and isolates the enemy carry with her ultimate. She loses to almost every tank and enchanter support.
Camille|sup.early_game: Play around walls: your Hookshot needs a wall to engage. At level 3, look for E from the river wall or the bushes, then Q and W. Don't leave the lane too early: the role quest penalizes you (see below).
Camille|sup.level_1: Hookshot (E) first. After that, max Q first.
Camille|sup.level_2: Precision Protocol (Q). Engage with your Hookshot, then Q (wait a moment before the recast for more damage).
Camille|sup.level_3: Tactical Sweep (W). Hit with the edge of the cone to slow and heal yourself.
Camille|sup.level_6: The Hextech Ultimatum: leap onto the enemy carry and trap them. Their team can't easily help them anymore: your ADC and jungler have to follow up.
power_spikes: Level 3: Hookshot engages from a wall.
Level 6: ultimate to isolate a carry.
First completed item: more dangerous dives.
Mid game: picks with your jungler.
Camille|sup.lane_plan: Engage from walls when your ADC can follow. Stay in the bot lane until level 5: since patch 26.16, your minion gold and XP are cut by a third elsewhere, which penalizes early roams. The support role quest then makes your Control Wards cheaper (40 gold, two stored).
Camille|sup.trading: All-in: E from a wall → Q → attacks → W (edge of the cone) → Q recast. Back off against supports who stop or disengage you (Rakan, Rell, Braum, Poppy, Janna, Lulu): don't dive while they have their abilities.
threats: Rakan and Rell, the worst matchups.
Braum, Poppy, Janna and Lulu: hard matchups.
Any CC that stops you mid-dive.
mistakes: Diving without your ADC or jungler.
Leaving the lane too early (role quest penalty).
Engaging with no wall nearby for your Hookshot.

matchup_notes.Thresh: Don't dive while he has his lantern to save his ADC.
matchup_notes.Lulu: Her polymorph stops you dead: wait until she's used it.
matchup_notes.Pyke: He's fragile: your ultimate isolates him.
matchup_notes.Xerath: He has no mobility: dive him from a wall.
matchup_notes.Rakan: His engages and shields outclass you: play defensively.

Camille|sup.mid_game: Look for picks with your jungler around objectives, engaging from walls. Place Control Wards.
Camille|sup.late_game: Wait for the enemy CC to be used, then Hookshot from a wall and ultimate on the enemy carry.
Camille|sup.ahead: Dive the carries and create picks.
Camille|sup.behind: Stay with your team and play counter-engages: ultimate on the enemy diver to protect your ADC.
Camille|sup.win_condition: To win this game, you want to isolate the enemy carry with your ultimate and kill them with your team.
Camille|sup.final_tip: Your Hookshot needs a wall: always position near a wall before looking for an engage.
